/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AshGeminiE.description: Obscure the identity of the killer within with this translucent ephemera. The mark of a Scoria assassin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AshGeminiE.descriptionEn: Obscure the identity of the killer within with this translucent ephemera. The mark of a Scoria assassin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AshGeminiE.descriptionZh: 用这种半透明的幻纹掩盖凶手的身份。这是火山石组织刺客的标志。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarBloo.name: Bleeding Body Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarBloo.descriptionZh: 散发出令人毛骨悚然的血腥效果。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarSmok.name: Smoking Body Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarSmok.description: A hazy smoke trail emanates from your Warframe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarSmok.descriptionEn: A hazy smoke trail emanates from your Warframe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/AvatarSmok.descriptionZh: 让战甲散发出朦胧的烟雾轨迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEpheme.name: Ki'Teer Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEpheme.description: Spread the influence of the System's greatest trader wherever you go!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEpheme.descriptionEn: Spread the influence of the System's greatest trader wherever you go!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEpheme.descriptionZh: 无论你身在何处，都扩散该星系最伟大商人的影响！

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.name: Eskhatos Ki'Teer Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.description: Those in the vicinity of this ephemera claim to hear baneful whispers, but surely these are fanciful tales.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.descriptionEn: Those in the vicinity of this ephemera claim to hear baneful whispers, but surely these are fanciful tales.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.descriptionZh: 据说靠近幻纹的人们能听到邪恶的低语，但这显然是些虚幻的传闻。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.name: Eskhatos Infinitas Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.description: This ephemera is an endless source of sinister style.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaroEvilEp.descriptionZh: This ephemera is an endless source of sinister style.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukDelu.name: Neviti Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukDelu.description: Encircled by harmonious energy, the shifting balance of conflict reveals itself in Baruuk Shaoshi's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukDelu.descriptionEn: Encircled by harmonious energy, the shifting balance of conflict reveals itself in Baruuk Shaoshi's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukDelu.descriptionZh: 在和谐能量的环绕下，冲突的微妙平衡在 Baruuk 少室的标志性幻纹中显露出来。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukPrim.name: Vaaditum Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukPrim.description: Honor your serenity and that of others as you display Baruuk's symbol. In relays, temporarily bestow the Vaaditum Prime Ephemera upon others.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukPrim.descriptionEn: Honor your serenity and that of others as you display Baruuk's symbol. In relays, temporarily bestow the Vaaditum Prime Ephemera upon others.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BaruukPrim.descriptionZh: 展示 Baruuk 的象征，尊重你与他人的宁静。在中继站中，可暂时将惟喜 Prime 幻纹赠予他人。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatsEpheme.name: Naberus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatsEpheme.description:
A warrior walks, alone in crowds
Companion to moon and mist and bat
With a vision grim the mind enshrouds
This fearsome, deathborne aristocrat.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatsEpheme.descriptionEn:
A warrior walks, alone in crowds
Companion to moon and mist and bat
With a vision grim the mind enshrouds
This fearsome, deathborne aristocrat.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatsEpheme.descriptionZh:
孤傲的战士，独行于族群
唯有月雾蝠，常伴其左右
眼神若冰霜，内心亦朦胧
化身为恐惧，死亡之贵族

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatWingsEp.name: Nyctalus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatWingsEp.description: Spread the membranous wings of night with this haunting Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatWingsEp.descriptionEn: Spread the membranous wings of night with this haunting Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/BatWingsEp.descriptionZh: 用这款阴魂不散的幻纹来展开夜之翅膜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CalibanDel.name: Heurodis Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CalibanDel.description: Carry the spirits of the Otherworld with you.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CalibanDel.descriptionEn: Carry the spirits of the Otherworld with you.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CalibanDel.descriptionZh: 与黄泉归来的灵魂作伴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CitrineDel.name: Didyma Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CitrineDel.description: Leave lingering sparks in the hearts of all you encounter with Citrine Aphrodita’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CitrineDel.descriptionEn: Leave lingering sparks in the hearts of all you encounter with Citrine Aphrodita’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CitrineDel.descriptionZh: Citrine 美神的标志性幻纹将在你遇到的所有人心中留下挥之不去的火花。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.name: Conquera II Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.description: Wear this floral Ephemera as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.descriptionEn: Wear this floral Ephemera as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.descriptionZh: 佩戴此花艺幻纹作为支持「征服癌症活动」的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.name: Conquera III Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.description: Wear this streaming ephemera as a symbol of support of the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation Quest.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Conquera20.descriptionZh: 佩戴这款流光幻纹，表达你对玛嘉烈公主癌症基金慈善活动的支持。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ConqueraEp.name: Conquera Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ConqueraEp.description: Wear this Ribbon Ephemera as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ConqueraEp.descriptionEn: Wear this Ribbon Ephemera as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ConqueraEp.descriptionZh: 佩戴此缎带幻纹作为支持「征服癌症活动」的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Sybillina Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: Information flows like live current through this Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionEn: Information flows like live current through this Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的、信息若电流般流淌的幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Zarina Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: A blazingly regal Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionEn: A blazingly regal Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的炽烈尊贵幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Gloriana Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: An icily imperious Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionEn: An icily imperious Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的冰冷傲慢幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Lucretia Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: Hatch venomous plots in this Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionEn: Hatch venomous plots in this Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的、生出恶毒阴谋的幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Solena Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: A magnetically compelling Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionEn: A magnetically compelling Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的磁性引力幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Hypatia Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: A radiant Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionEn: A radiant Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的辐射幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.name: Kyruna Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.description: A striking Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionEn: A striking Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CorpusLich.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的冲击幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CupidWings.name: Eros Wings Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CupidWings.description: Wings to lift your love starward.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CupidWings.descriptionEn: Wings to lift your love starward.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/CupidWings.descriptionZh: 让你的爱展翅飞向星空。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DeimosEphe.name: Festering Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DeimosEphe.description: Pestilent sores and bubbles burst with your every move.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DeimosEphe.descriptionEn: Pestilent sores and bubbles burst with your every move.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DeimosEphe.descriptionZh: 致命的脓包随着你的一举一动而膨胀爆裂。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DexEphemer.name: Dex Laurus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DexEphemer.description: Commemorate 12 cycles since the Tenno first awoke with this graceful ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DexEphemer.descriptionEn: Commemorate 12 cycles since the Tenno first awoke with this graceful ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DexEphemer.descriptionZh: 通过这款优雅的幻纹纪念 Tenno 首次苏醒以来的 12 个周期。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DogDaysEph.name: Dog Days Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DogDaysEph.description: Soak off with this Dog Days Ephemera - Only for a limited time!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DogDaysEph.descriptionEn: Soak off with this Dog Days Ephemera - Only for a limited time!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DogDaysEph.descriptionZh: 沉浸在这个三伏天幻纹中 — 仅在限定时间内可用！

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistEph.name: Gangrim Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistEph.description: May a chill descend upon you with the frozen embrace of Narin's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistEph.descriptionZh: 愿 Narin 的标志性幻纹将寒意伴着冰冷的拥抱降临于你。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistSpi.name: Seonang Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistSpi.description: Call on a frosty spirit to swirl around you.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/DuelistSpi.descriptionZh: 召唤冰霜精灵环绕着你。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraGa.name: Catena Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraGa.description: Levitating crystals weave a web of luminous connections. Gara Prime’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraGa.descriptionEn: Levitating crystals weave a web of luminous connections. Gara Prime’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraGa.descriptionZh: 轻盈的水晶编织出晶莹剔透的网。Gara Prime 的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraNe.name: Baurahn Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraNe.description: Coiling, hissing, the spirits of flame ride with their kin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraNe.descriptionEn: Coiling, hissing, the spirits of flame ride with their kin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraNe.descriptionZh: 盘旋缠绕、嘶嘶作响，烈焰之灵与其亲族同行。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraPr.name: Corposant Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraPr.description: Luminous plasma leaps off surfaces in your presence.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraPr.nameZh: 圣艾尔摩之火 Prime 幻纹
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraPr.descriptionEn: Luminous plasma leaps off surfaces in your presence.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/EphemeraPr.descriptionZh: 发光的等离子体会在你所经之处跃出地面。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.name: Spring Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.description: Mark the path to a new season with a trail of decorative eggs - only for a limited time!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.descriptionEn: Mark the path to a new season with a trail of decorative eggs - only for a limited time!
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.descriptionZh: 布置装饰性蛋来标记通往新季节的道路-只在限定的时间内！

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.name: Eidolon Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.description: Move as the Eidolons and burn the ground coldly with footsteps of shimmering Void energy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.descriptionEn: Move as the Eidolons and burn the ground coldly with footsteps of shimmering Void energy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.descriptionZh: 像夜灵般移步，以闪烁的虚空能量，无情地践踏并焚烧地面。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.name: Shocking Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.description: Your Warframe leaves crackling footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.descriptionEn: Your Warframe leaves crackling footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsE.descriptionZh: 让战甲在身后留下劈啪作响的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsH.name: Blazing Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsH.description: Your Warframe leaves flaming footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsH.descriptionEn: Your Warframe leaves flaming footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsH.descriptionZh: 让战甲在身后留下火焰般的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsI.name: Freezing Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsI.description: Your Warframe leaves icy footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsI.descriptionEn: Your Warframe leaves icy footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsI.descriptionZh: 让战甲在身后留下结冰的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsM.name: Fae Path Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsM.description: Leave a trail of fireflies and forest leaves in your wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsM.descriptionEn: Leave a trail of fireflies and forest leaves in your wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsM.descriptionZh: 在你身后留下一道萤火虫和树叶的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsP.name: Seeding Step Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsP.description: Your Warframe leaves grassy footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsP.descriptionEn: Your Warframe leaves grassy footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/FootstepsP.descriptionZh: 让战甲在身后留下绿意盎然的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaBloo.name: Viserakta Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaBloo.description: Bathe in the life essence of your enemies.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaBloo.descriptionEn: Bathe in the life essence of your enemies.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaBloo.descriptionZh: 在敌人的生命精华中徜徉。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaPrim.name: Sanguinax Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaPrim.description: Spread Garuda Prime's wings of slaughter with this flowing Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaPrim.descriptionEn: Spread Garuda Prime's wings of slaughter with this flowing Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GarudaPrim.descriptionZh: 用这款流动的幻纹展开 Garuda Prime 的杀戮之翼。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelDel.name: Fraktur Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelDel.description: The ground trembles to herald your arrival. Grendel Turbis' signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelDel.descriptionEn: The ground trembles to herald your arrival. Grendel Turbis' signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelDel.descriptionZh: 大地震颤，宣告你的到来。Grendel 暴坦的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelPri.name: Oni Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelPri.description: Take on the look of a monster that can devour an enemy in a single bite.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelPri.descriptionEn: Take on the look of a monster that can devour an enemy in a single bite.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/GrendelPri.descriptionZh: 呈现出一个能一口吞噬敌人的怪物形象。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Heart-Throb Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'Time will show the way, And I'll mend the heart you've broken'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionEn:
"Time will show the way, And I'll mend the heart you've broken"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionZh:
'年华流逝，我将愈合你心上的伤口'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Tail Feather Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'Please stay
Don't put out the flame and run away'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionEn:
"Please stay
Don't put out the flame and run away"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionZh:
'请留在我身边
留下情热的火焰'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Heart-Beat Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'In this heart break
I'll be here fighting for you'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionEn:
"In this heart break
I'll be here fighting for you"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionZh:
'遍体鳞伤
依然为你而战'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Luv-Byte Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'With a flicker of hope on the darkest of days
Now it feels like the end is near'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionEn:
"With a flicker of hope on the darkest of days
Now it feels like the end is near"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionZh:
'在最黑暗的日子里，仍怀揣着一丝希望
现在感觉结局已经临近'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Pins-N-Needles Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'I thought I could take
More than I really can'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionEn:
"I thought I could take
More than I really can"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionZh:
'我以为我可以承受
比实际的更多'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Embracer Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'Baby 'til you come back with something
I know I'll never let it go'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionEn:
"Baby 'til you come back with something
I know I'll never let it go"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionZh:
'宝贝，除非你带点什么回来
我知道我永远不会放手'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Lovestruck Ephemera

'I'm getting stronger but I still feel the pain'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionEn:
"I'm getting stronger but I still feel the pain"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionZh:
'纵然身强体壮，心痛却无处隐藏'

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.name: Soul-Eye Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.description:
'I keep thinking I see you
And there's nobody there'

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InfestedLi.descriptionEn:
"I keep thinking I see you
And there's nobody there"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.name: Primatura Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.description: A fresh coating of ink marks the first step taken on the road to understanding the truth of the Shadowgrapher.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.descriptionEn: A fresh coating of ink marks the first step taken on the road to understanding the truth of the Shadowgrapher.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.descriptionZh: 新的墨水涂层标志着我们踏上了揭开绘影者真相的第一步。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.name: Pareidola Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.description: To see truth in the shapes created by this ephemera is a mark of increased understanding.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.descriptionEn: To see truth in the shapes created by this ephemera is a mark of increased understanding.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.descriptionZh: 能从幻纹所构成的形态中洞察真相，正是理解力日益深厚的标志。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.name: Liftbalon Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.description: Celebrate the completion of Follie's Shadowgraph during Operation: Atramentum with a festive collection of balloons.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.descriptionEn: Celebrate the completion of Follie's Shadowgraph during Operation: Atramentum with a festive collection of balloons.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/InkEphemer.descriptionZh: 通过这套节日气球的幻纹，在《行动代号：墨痕》中庆祝 Follie 的绘影图的完成。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.name: Aspirus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.description: Pay tribute to Jade and mark the battle of Operation Belly of the Beast with this transcendent Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.descriptionEn: Pay tribute to Jade and mark the battle of Operation Belly of the Beast with this transcendent Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.descriptionZh: 用个超凡的幻纹来向 Jade 致敬，并纪念《行动代号：兽之腹》的战斗。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.name: Aspirus Emergent Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.description: An even more radiant evolution of the Aspirus Ephemera, created with vestiges over Jade's volatile motes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.descriptionEn: An even more radiant evolution of the Aspirus Ephemera, created with vestiges over Jade's volatile motes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.descriptionZh: 由 Jade 不稳定微粒留下的痕迹所形成，是追梦幻纹更加耀眼的进化版本。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.name: Aspirus Apex Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.description: The pinnacle version of this ephemera, signifying victory over Parvos Granum’s forces in Operation Belly of the Beast.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.descriptionEn: The pinnacle version of this ephemera, signifying victory over Parvos Granum’s forces in Operation Belly of the Beast.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/JadeLightE.descriptionZh: 这是此幻纹的巅峰版本，象征着在《行动代号：兽之腹》中战胜帕尔沃斯·格拉努的军队。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaF.name: Vengeful Flame Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaF.description: A fiery ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaF.descriptionEn: A fiery ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaF.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的炽烈幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.name: Vengeful Chill Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.description: An icy ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.descriptionEn: An icy ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的冰凉幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.name: Vengeful Shockwave Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.description: An ephemera that echoes punishing impacts, seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.descriptionEn: An ephemera that echoes punishing impacts, seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaI.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的惩戒性冲击回声幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaL.name: Vengeful Charge Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaL.description: A shocking ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaL.descriptionEn: A shocking ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaL.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的电击幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaM.name: Vengeful Pull Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaM.description: A magnetic ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaM.descriptionEn: A magnetic ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaM.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的磁力幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.name: Vengeful Toxin Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.description: An ephemera of toxic miasma seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.descriptionEn: An ephemera of toxic miasma seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.descriptionZh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的毒性瘴气幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.name: Vengeful Trickster Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.description: The energy of the trickster Warframes is embodied in this colorful ephemera, seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.descriptionEn: The energy of the trickster Warframes is embodied in this colorful ephemera, seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Kuva/KuvaT.descriptionZh: 战甲骗术的能量包含在这个多彩的幻纹里，从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LavosDelux.name: Ophodryx Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LavosDelux.description: Ethereal serpents slither in your caustic wake with Lavos Khymia’s signature Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LavosDelux.descriptionEn: Ethereal serpents slither in your caustic wake with Lavos Khymia’s signature Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LavosDelux.descriptionZh: 通过 Lavos 点金标志性的幻纹，空灵的蛇影将在你留下的腐蚀性尾迹中蜿蜒爬行。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYDragonE.name: Xianglong Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYDragonE.description: A dragon’s spirit graces your path.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYDragonE.descriptionEn: A dragon’s spirit graces your path.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYDragonE.descriptionZh: 祥龙之气为你的道路增光添彩。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYKaitheD.name: Malaen Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYKaitheD.description: Bring forth the fiery steeds of Dagath Yfari’s signature ephemera to follow in your footsteps.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYKaitheD.descriptionEn: Bring forth the fiery steeds of Dagath Yfari’s signature ephemera to follow in your footsteps.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYKaitheD.descriptionZh: 让 Dagath 伊法里的标志性幻纹中那些炽热的骏马追随你的脚步。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYStonesE.name: Heaven Stones Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYStonesE.description: Step lightly with stones that could mend the very fabric of the heavens.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYStonesE.descriptionEn: Step lightly with stones that could mend the very fabric of the heavens.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LNYStonesE.descriptionZh: 随着轻盈的脚步踏出能够修补天空的五色石。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LotusFlowe.name: Lotus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LotusFlowe.description: Leave a trail of fragrant petals in your wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LotusFlowe.descriptionEn: Leave a trail of fragrant petals in your wake.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LotusFlowe.descriptionZh: 在你身后留下一道芬芳花瓣的足迹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LunarEphem.name: Purified Bloom Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LunarEphem.description: Flourish out of the muddiness of war.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LunarEphem.descriptionEn: Flourish out of the muddiness of war.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/LunarEphem.descriptionZh: 在战争的泥沼中繁茂生长。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock two additional looks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.descriptionEn: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock two additional looks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.descriptionZh: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化幻纹。装备这款幻纹获取专精点数时会额外解锁两个外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Emergent Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock an additional look.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.descriptionEn: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock an additional look.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.descriptionZh: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化幻纹。装备这款幻纹获取专精点数时会额外解锁一个外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Apex Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.descriptionEn: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NarmerEvol.descriptionZh: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveD.name: Wirematrix Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveD.description: Embrace the look of 1999's most cutting-edge video game technology with this wireframe-themed Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveD.descriptionEn: Embrace the look of 1999's most cutting-edge video game technology with this wireframe-themed Ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveD.descriptionZh: 通过这款以数字线战甲为主题的幻纹，你将领略到 1999 年最前沿电子游戏技术的风采。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveI.name: Waveform Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveI.description: Sweet frequencies ripple through this Nightwave themed ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveI.descriptionEn: Sweet frequencies ripple through this Nightwave themed ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NightwaveI.descriptionZh: 甜蜜频率回荡于这个以午夜电波为主题的幻纹中。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoEphem.name: Sprodling Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoEphem.description: Baby sprods just love to have fun! Three bounce around your feet with Nokko’s signature ephemera, a playful reminder of the future of the Deepmines.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoEphem.descriptionEn: Baby sprods just love to have fun! Three bounce around your feet with Nokko’s signature ephemera, a playful reminder of the future of the Deepmines.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoEphem.descriptionZh: 菌宝就是喜欢玩耍！Nokko 的标志性幻纹会在你脚边蹦蹦跳跳，调皮地提醒你深矿的未来。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoFoots.name: Rizoma Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoFoots.description: Everything is connected. Spores linger in your footsteps with this ephemera, evoking the underground web of life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoFoots.descriptionEn: Everything is connected. Spores linger in your footsteps with this ephemera, evoking the underground web of life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NokkoFoots.descriptionZh: 万物皆有联系。孢子会随着这些幻纹萦绕在你的脚印，唤起地下的生命之网。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NovaDeluxe.name: Maru Obi Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NovaDeluxe.description: The perfect flourish for a graceful Tenno.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NovaDeluxe.descriptionEn: The perfect flourish for a graceful Tenno.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/NovaDeluxe.descriptionZh: 优雅 Tenno 的完美修饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OpulaEphem.name: Opula Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OpulaEphem.description: Surround yourself with the dancing light of full spectrum flames.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OpulaEphem.descriptionEn: Surround yourself with the dancing light of full spectrum flames.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OpulaEphem.descriptionZh: 让自己沉浸在全光谱火焰的舞动光芒之中。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OraxiaEphe.name: Zygiella Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OraxiaEphe.description: Surround yourself with the growing dread of Oraxia's presence.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OraxiaEphe.descriptionEn: Surround yourself with the growing dread of Oraxia's presence.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OraxiaEphe.descriptionZh: 让自己沉浸在因 Oraxia 的存在而产生的日益增长的恐惧之中。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OrbsEpheme.name: Trio Orbit Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OrbsEpheme.description: Surround yourself with a trio of orbiting energy -  earned on the Steel Path.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OrbsEpheme.descriptionEn: Surround yourself with a trio of orbiting energy -  earned on the Steel Path.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/OrbsEpheme.descriptionZh: 三道绕轨能量在你身上环绕 — 在钢铁之路上获取。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PeachBloss.name: Peach Blossom Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PeachBloss.description: Surround your Warframe with softly falling peach blossoms, to celebrate the Lunar Renewal.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PeachBloss.descriptionEn: Surround your Warframe with softly falling peach blossoms, to celebrate the Lunar Renewal.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PeachBloss.descriptionZh: 用轻柔的桃花包围你的战甲，用以庆贺新春佳节。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PrimeVorun.name: Okuri Tails Prime Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PrimeVorun.description: The beast may be adorned, but never tamed. Voruna Prime's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PrimeVorun.descriptionEn: The beast may be adorned, but never tamed. Voruna Prime's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/PrimeVorun.descriptionZh: 野兽或许可以穿着华服，但永远不会被驯服。Voruna Prime 的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ProteaDelu.name: Tealtrian Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ProteaDelu.description: Distinguish yourself with the essence of nobility.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/ProteaDelu.descriptionEn: Distinguish yourself with the essence of nobility.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/QorvexDelu.name: Belfri Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/QorvexDelu.description: Beckon Qorvex Basilica's fluttering fellows to your side with his signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/QorvexDelu.descriptionZh: 通过他的标志性幻纹，将 Qorvex 圣殿里那些翩翩起舞的伙伴们召唤到你身边。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SandmanEph.name: Sands of Mars Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SandmanEph.description: Let the familiar sands of Mars accompany you.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SandmanEph.descriptionEn: Let the familiar sands of Mars accompany you.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SandmanEph.descriptionZh: 让熟悉的火星之沙陪伴着你。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SentientDe.name: Tenebrous Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SentientDe.descriptionZh: 行走在 Sentient 阴影的缭绕下。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SmokeEphem.name: Fog of War Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SmokeEphem.description: Emerge from the fog of war unscathed.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SmokeEphem.descriptionEn: Emerge from the fog of war unscathed.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SmokeEphem.descriptionZh: 毫发无伤地从战争迷雾中现身。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SnowEpheme.name: Frostfall Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SnowEpheme.description: Become the heart of the winter, beneath a cloud of falling snow.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SnowEpheme.descriptionEn: Become the heart of the winter, beneath a cloud of falling snow.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/SnowEpheme.descriptionZh: 在一片雪花飘落的云朵下化作冬日之心。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TatsuSkull.name: Crania Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TatsuSkull.description: Surround yourself with the echoes of the fallen - earned on the Steel Path.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TatsuSkull.descriptionEn: Surround yourself with the echoes of the fallen - earned on the Steel Path.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TatsuSkull.descriptionZh: 亡者的余音在你身上环绕 — 在钢铁之路上获取。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.name: TennoCon 2021 Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.description: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2021.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.descriptionEn: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2021.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.descriptionZh: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2021 的玩家。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.name: Hunhullus Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.description: Emulating the colossus of Hull, this ephemera is a reminder of the Tenno's past conflicts.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.descriptionEn: Emulating the colossus of Hull, this ephemera is a reminder of the Tenno's past conflicts.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TennoCon20.descriptionZh: 效仿舰体的宏观之形，这个幻纹唤起了 Tenno 对昔日冲突的追忆。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Twitch2023.name: Raya Aurora Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Twitch2023.description: Evoke the awe and beauty of solar winds with this delicate ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Twitch2023.descriptionEn: Evoke the awe and beauty of solar winds with this delicate ephemera.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/Twitch2023.descriptionZh: 通过这款精致的幻纹，唤起太阳风暴的浩瀚与美丽。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TwitchEphe.name: Verv Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TwitchEphe.description: Broadcast your presence with every move.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TwitchEphe.descriptionEn: Broadcast your presence with every move.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/TwitchEphe.descriptionZh: 通过一举一动来宣告你的存在。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VoidAngelE.name: Raptwing Ephemera
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Effects/VoidAngelE.description: Take on the majesty of an angel’s wings.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.name: Gynfas Kaithe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.description: The Tales of Duviri tell of the Gynfas Kaithe visiting homes on a moonless night. To deny it entry is to invite dire misfortune. A fitting steed for Dagath Yfari.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.descriptionZh: 《双衍王境故事集》讲述了画布绝灵骥会在无月之夜造访各家各户。将它拒之门外会招致可怕的厄运。它是 Dagath 伊法里的最佳坐骑。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.descriptionEn: The macabre light of the Gynfas Kaithe’s tail has haunted many a moor and battlefield.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/DagathDeluxe.descriptionZh: 画布绝灵骥尾巴上那阴森的光芒，曾萦绕许多荒野和战场。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Vexage Coronet

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.descriptionZh: 事先警告，对于任何挑战你的绝灵骥和它的骑手的人，愤怒在等待着他们。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Dauntair Coronet

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.descriptionZh: 一位熟练的骑手将虚空的印记重新应用在他的绝灵骥上。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Myrthen Coronet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.description: Joy blossoms in the Myrthen Coronet.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.descriptionEn: Joy blossoms in the Myrthen Coronet.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.descriptionZh: 欢乐在欢馨马冠中开花。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Enverve Coronet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.description: The Enverve Coronet elegantly expresses a bitter emotion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.descriptionEn: The Enverve Coronet elegantly expresses a bitter emotion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.descriptionZh: 激妒马冠优雅地传达了一种苦涩的情感。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.name: Wistfall Coronet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.description: The Wistfall Coronet depicts melancholy’s beauty.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.descriptionEn: The Wistfall Coronet depicts melancholy’s beauty.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/Effects/Hors.descriptionZh: 忧泣马冠展示了忧郁之美。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.name: Aetigo Kaithe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.description: Aetigo Kaithes are a native species of Duviri's southernmost island. Their emerald eyes once reflected the verdant plains they roamed, but when the island was reduced to ash, their eyes faded to nothing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.descriptionEn: Aetigo Kaithes are a native species of Duviri's southernmost island. Their emerald eyes once reflected the verdant plains they roamed, but when the island was reduced to ash, their eyes faded to nothing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.descriptionZh: 因理绝灵骥是双衍王境最南端岛屿的本地物种。它们祖母绿色的眼眸曾经映照着它们踏过的青翠平原，但当岛屿化为灰烬之时，它们的眼睛也随之消逝。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.name: Psyacus Kaithe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.description: Psyacus Kaithes inspire fear in the faint of heart. Common wisdom among Duviri citizens holds that those who mount the Psyacus Kaithe must be either courageous or heartless.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.descriptionEn: Psyacus Kaithes inspire fear in the faint of heart. Common wisdom among Duviri citizens holds that those who mount the Psyacus Kaithe must be either courageous or heartless.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.descriptionZh: 心道绝灵骥会在懦夫的心中唤起恐惧。双衍王境的民众普遍认为，那些骑上心道绝灵骥的人要么勇敢，要么无情。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.name: Histornam Kaithe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.description: It is said that the great Dominus Thrax prefers Histornam Kaithes above all other breeds. It was on the back of a Histornam Kaithe that Thrax himself learned to ride.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.descriptionEn: It is said that the great Dominus Thrax prefers Histornam Kaithes above all other breeds. It was on the back of a Histornam Kaithe that Thrax himself learned to ride.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzBodySk.descriptionZh: 有言说伟大的士魂大帝最喜史源绝灵骥，胜于其他的所有品种。正是在一匹史源的背上，士魂大帝本人学会了骑乘。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.name: Sviari Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.description: The might of the Kaithe rider is expressed through the Sviari Chamfron's sharp horns.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.descriptionEn: The might of the Kaithe rider is expressed through the Sviari Chamfron's sharp horns.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.descriptionZh: 绝灵骥骑手的力量表现在瑞豚马盔的锋利之角上。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.name: Dyrncaul Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.description: The Dyrncaul Chamfron’s curved horns are reminiscent of the Tamm, a creature whose happiness is said to bring good fortune.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.descriptionEn: The Dyrncaul Chamfron’s curved horns are reminiscent of the Tamm, a creature whose happiness is said to bring good fortune.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.descriptionZh: 勇角马盔的弯角让人想起塔牧羊，据说它的快乐会带来好运。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.name: Irdeni Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.description: The Irdeni Chamfron is reminiscent of the ever-changing hues in Duviri’s sky.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.descriptionEn: The Irdeni Chamfron is reminiscent of the ever-changing hues in Duviri’s sky.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.descriptionZh: 复斓马盔让人想起双衍王境中千变万化的色调。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.name: Kheyur Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.description: The Kheyur Chamfron befits any formal occasion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.descriptionEn: The Kheyur Chamfron befits any formal occasion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseH.descriptionZh: 华金马盔适合任何正式场合。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.name: Dovin Saddle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.description: The Dovin Saddle's deep curve and lightweight structure make for strong balance and gentle communication with the Kaithe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.descriptionEn: The Dovin Saddle's deep curve and lightweight structure make for strong balance and gentle communication with the Kaithe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.descriptionZh: 迹语石马鞍深沉的曲线和轻巧的结构使得绝灵骥兼具良好的平衡性和易于与骑手交流。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.name: Vaidurian Saddle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.description: The Vaidurian Saddle’s comfortable and sturdy design is ideal for those long hours riding Kaithes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.descriptionEn: The Vaidurian Saddle’s comfortable and sturdy design is ideal for those long hours riding Kaithes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.descriptionZh: 猫睛石马鞍舒适坚固的设计非常适合长时间骑乘绝灵骥。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.name: Sohseki Saddle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.description: Style and comfort meet in the Sohseki Saddle. Its padding provides stability and protection during jumps.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.descriptionEn: Style and comfort meet in the Sohseki Saddle. Its padding provides stability and protection during jumps.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseS.descriptionZh: 杀生石马鞍兼具酷炫与舒适的特性。它的填充物在跳跃过程中具备很好的稳定性和保护性。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Caersid Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: The Caersid Tail bespeaks the spirit of the vengeful warrior.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionEn: The Caersid Tail bespeaks the spirit of the vengeful warrior.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionZh: 战坞马尾彰显着复仇战士的精神。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Heoro Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: A Kaithe with the Heoro Tail evokes glory.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionEn: A Kaithe with the Heoro Tail evokes glory.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionZh: 拥有荣英马尾的绝灵骥召唤出荣耀。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Velific Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: Adorn the movements of an elegant Kaithe with the Velific Tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionEn: Adorn the movements of an elegant Kaithe with the Velific Tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionZh: 用灵现马尾装饰优雅的绝灵骥的动作。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Aebolg Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: Bones laid bare in the Aebolg Tail are a reminder to appreciate the gift of life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionEn: Bones laid bare in the Aebolg Tail are a reminder to appreciate the gift of life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionZh: 骨棘马尾上裸露的骨头提醒着人们珍惜生命的馈赠。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Histornam Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: The Histornam Kaithe came into being with this regal tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionEn: The Histornam Kaithe came into being with this regal tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionZh: 史源绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条华丽的尾巴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Aetigo Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: The Aetigo Kaithe came into being with this dignified tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionEn: The Aetigo Kaithe came into being with this dignified tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionZh: 因理绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条气派的尾巴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.name: Psyacus Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.description: The Psyacus Kaithe came into being with this tapered tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionEn: The Psyacus Kaithe came into being with this tapered tail.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseT.descriptionZh: 心道绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条锥形尾巴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseW.name: Exorion Wings
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseW.description: Outstretched wings reveal the path to celestial planes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseW.descriptionEn: Outstretched wings reveal the path to celestial planes.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/ErsatzHorseW.descriptionZh: 展开的双翼揭示了通往天外位面之径。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.name: Aethon Chamfron
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.description: Fan the flames of fortitude with the Aethon Chamfron.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.descriptionEn: Fan the flames of fortitude with the Aethon Chamfron.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.descriptionZh: 用神驱马盔扇起坚韧的火焰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.name: Aethon Saddle
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.description: The Aethon Saddle's flames don't burn the skilled rider.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.descriptionEn: The Aethon Saddle's flames don't burn the skilled rider.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.descriptionZh: 神驱马鞍上的火焰并不会灼伤熟练的骑手。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.name: Aethon Tail
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.description: The Aethon Tail is a good companion piece to the rider of fleet-footed fire.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.descriptionEn: The Aethon Tail is a good companion piece to the rider of fleet-footed fire.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/GaussDeluxeH.descriptionZh: 神驱马尾是迅猛骑手的好搭档配件。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/HorseHelmetD.name: /Lotus/Language/Horse/HorseHelmetDraperyName
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/HorseHelmetD.descriptionEn: Beware the fearsome yet elegant curves of the Aumen Chamfron's horns.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/HorseHelmetD.descriptionZh: 当心金兆马鞍锐利的角及其可怖而优雅的弧度。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/HorseSaddleD.name: /Lotus/Language/Horse/HorseSaddleDraperyName
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/HorseSaddleD.descriptionEn: Stylish spikes bely the true comfort of the Aumen Saddle.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/HorseSaddleD.descriptionZh: 金兆马鞍虽有时髦尖刺，实则舒适无比。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/HorseTailDra.name: /Lotus/Language/Horse/HorseTailDraperyName
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Horse/HorseTailDra.descriptionEn: A grand tail for a magnificent beast.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.name: Skaut Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.description:
A Grineer Bolkor remodeled for Tenno reinforcement. Skaut's alert signal calls Kahl and his Grineer brothers for backup. When backup is active, use the alert signal to replenish your squad's health. Each squad member can call one additional Grineer brother to join the fight.

Also available in the Market after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.descriptionEn:
A Grineer Bolkor remodeled for Tenno reinforcement. Skaut's alert signal calls Kahl and his Grineer brothers for backup. When backup is active, use the alert signal to replenish your squad's health. Each squad member can call one additional Grineer brother to join the fight.

Also available in the Market after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/GrineerShip/.descriptionZh:
一艘为了 Tenno 增援而重新改装的 Grineer 博寇。伺航的警报信号呼叫卡尔和他的 Grineer 兄弟们来支援。当支援起作用时，使用警报信号来补充你的小队生命值。每个小队成员可以额外呼叫一名 Grineer 兄弟加入战斗。

完成《破障者》系列任务后也可在商店内购得。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.name: Parallax Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.description: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.descriptionZh: （英文：PARALLAX）星察是为扎里曼的行星研究而设计的。它可部署先进的奥罗金之眼空中支援，可让殖民者在登陆前研究稀有资源丰富的地区。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.descriptionZh: 当乘客搭乘星察离开「扎里曼号」前去研究 Tau 星系岩石或荒地的地形时，星察就会被装备上脊岩外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ZarimanShip/.name: Parallax Mesaen Skin

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Embol.description: A disgusting little nib of flesh to infest the hilt of any Melee Weapon.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Embol.descriptionZh: 一小段能感染任何近战武器握柄的恶心肉须。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/ESGrn.name: Boloket Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/ESGrn.description: Fashioned by frontline grunts, this military-grade weapon embellishment was built to withstand the stresses of combat.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/EvilB.name: Eskhatos Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/EvilB.description: This intricately knotted sugatra may have adorned the weapons of the Queen's Guard in a not-so-distant future.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/EvilB.descriptionZh: 这种精巧的绳结坠饰或许会在不久的将来成为女皇护卫的武器上的装饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/FireM.name: Pyra Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/FireM.description: During the height of the Old War, Tenno raiders used these flaming sugatras to intimidate and distract enemies.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/FireM.name: Pyra Opula Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/FireM.description: Every eye will be drawn to this iridescent sugatra.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/GrnMe.name: Caggro Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/GrnMe.description: Only Grineer who have proven their strength in combat can brandish these.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/GrnQu.description: Ripped from the blade of a fallen Kuva Guardian.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/GrnQu.descriptionZh: 取自于战败赤毒守卫者的武器。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/IceMe.name: Scyth Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/IceMe.description: A crystallized companion to the Sibear hammer.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/IceMe.descriptionEn: A crystallized companion to the Sibear hammer.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/IceMe.descriptionZh: 一具搭配西伯利亚战锤的水晶配件。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Infes.description: Fashion elites across the system are discovering the sophisticated style of benign mutalist growths. Equip this undulating sugatra and find out what you're missing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Infes.descriptionEn: Fashion elites across the system are discovering the sophisticated style of benign mutalist growths. Equip this undulating sugatra and find out what you're missing.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/Infes.descriptionZh: 时尚精英们正在星系中持续发掘良性异融主义的复杂成长方式。装备这个波状的坠饰，看看你还缺少什么。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/InfSh.name: Keratose Sugatra
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/InfSh.description: This Infested sugatra is a benign cellular growth self-protected by chitinous plates.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/MeleeDangles/InfSh.descriptionEn: This Infested sugatra is a benign cellular growth self-protected by chitinous plates.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionEn: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionZh: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Operator Keeler Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionEn: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionZh: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Operator Orizu Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionEn: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionZh: 这款以千纸鹤为灵感的外观会带来长寿与保护。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Saita Prime Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A suit of an Operator outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionEn: A suit of an Operator outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionZh: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Templar Prime Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The dress uniform worn with pride by Harrow's faithful legions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.nameZh: 圣殿骑士 Prime 套服
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionEn: The dress uniform worn with pride by Harrow's faithful legions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionZh: Harrow 那忠诚的军团自豪地穿戴这套制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Clearvoy Prime Suit
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionEn: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionZh: 唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Necra Prime Cuirass
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: Necrotic accents define this testament to the Entrati family’s aesthetic. Perhaps there’s a lesson in how those who gaze into the Void find beauty in the fusion of luxury and oblivion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionEn: Necrotic accents define this testament to the Entrati family’s aesthetic. Perhaps there’s a lesson in how those who gaze into the Void find beauty in the fusion of luxury and oblivion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionZh: 腐生的特质是英择谛家族美学的见证。也许这是一个教训，告诉那些凝视虚空的人如何在奢华与虚无的融合中发现美。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.name: Tauron Prime Regalia
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.description: The Tauron Academy uniform blends Tenno functionality with Sentient design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionEn: The Tauron Academy uniform blends Tenno functionality with Sentient design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/BodySuits.descriptionZh: 将 Tenno 的特能与 Sentient 设计融为一体的 Tauron 学院制服。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Adu.descriptionZh: 给漂泊者使用的时尚配件

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Dri.name: Kaneshell Atomicycle Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Dri.description: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Dri.nameZh: 凯恩壳原子摩托车头盔
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Dri.descriptionEn: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Dri.descriptionZh: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Zariman Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to an Operator outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: A hood belonging to an Operator outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 一顶属于指挥官套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Zariman Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: The Drifter's Zariman hood. Still intact after all these years.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: The Drifter's Zariman hood. Still intact after all these years.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 漂泊者的扎里曼头罩。饱经岁月洗礼却仍旧完好。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Feldune Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Koppra Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A ragged old cloth hood and leather mask worn by The Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: A ragged old cloth hood and leather mask worn by The Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 漂泊者所穿的破旧布制头罩和皮制面具。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Escuchon Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Venture boldly forth, clad in the auspices of one who shows courage in the face of death.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Venture boldly forth, clad in the auspices of one who shows courage in the face of death.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 穿上无畏死亡的勇气之士的铠甲，英勇向前。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Voidshell Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Manduka Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Hawk Bishamo Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Lark Bishamo Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Harrier Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Dex Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 10 周年。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Keeler Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Drifter Grineer Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer face shield and hood. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer face shield and hood. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 通过这些搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵面罩和兜帽深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Ceno Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 一款充满设计感的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Vahd Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 以坚定的目标和清晰的愿景而打造。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Zauba Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 受到年迈预言家的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Grunge Hood
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 穿上灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Outrider Mask
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.description: Drifter armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionEn: Drifter armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.descriptionZh: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Operator/Hoods/Hoo.name: Emissary Hood
