/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynA.descriptionZh: 米尼娃的标志性太阳镜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynH.name: Saryn Prime Helmet
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynH.description: The standard issue helmet for the Saryn Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynH.descriptionEn: The standard issue helmet for the Saryn Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynS.name: Minerva Gemini Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynS.description:
Minerva Hendricks, former Libertatian military agent, brings a human face to the Saryn Warframe.

Switch between Saryn and Minerva's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Minerva Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynS.descriptionEn:
Minerva Hendricks, former Libertatian military agent, brings a human face to the Saryn Warframe.

Switch between Saryn and Minerva's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Minerva Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Saryn/WF1999SarynS.descriptionZh:
米尼娃·亨德里克斯是前自由军特工，她为 Saryn 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的米尼娃双子表情动作，在 Saryn 和米尼娃的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AmazonOniS.name: Stezia Sumbha Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AmazonOniS.description: Like a carnivorous flower, this alluring Syandana conceals a dangerous predator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AmazonOniS.descriptionEn: Like a carnivorous flower, this alluring Syandana conceals a dangerous predator.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AmazonOniS.descriptionZh: 就像一朵肉食性的花一样，这件披饰的诱人外表下潜藏着一个危险的捕食者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/April2015S.name: Kyroptera Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/April2015S.description: A Tenno Syandana evocative of winged night creatures.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/April2015S.descriptionEn: A Tenno Syandana evocative of winged night creatures.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/April2015S.descriptionZh: 一件 Tenno 披饰，令人联想到有翅膀的夜之生物。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ArmScarf.name: Yomo Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ArmScarf.description: A traditional garment, popular with high ranking Tenno.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ArmScarf.descriptionEn: A traditional garment, popular with high ranking Tenno.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ArmScarf.descriptionZh: 一件传统服装，在高等 Tenno 中很受欢迎。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AtlasDelux.name: Stratum Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AtlasDelux.description: Austere crystalline beauty, formed over time, deceptively delicate, lethally sharp. The Stratum Syandana perfectly compliments Karst, Atlas' deluxe skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AtlasDelux.descriptionEn: Austere crystalline beauty, formed over time, deceptively delicate, lethally sharp. The Stratum Syandana perfectly compliments Karst, Atlas' deluxe skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/AtlasDelux.descriptionZh: 随着时间的推移形成了简朴的结晶美，看似脆弱却又尖锐致命。地层披饰完美地装点了岩溶， Atlas 的华丽外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape.name: Ki'Teer Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape.description: Walk the cutting edge of fashion with this exclusive Ki'Teer original.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape.descriptionEn: Walk the cutting edge of fashion with this exclusive Ki'Teer original.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape.descriptionZh: 搭配 Ki'teer 原创的独占披饰，行于时尚的锐利锋缘。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2R.name: Ki'Teer Razza Elixis Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2R.description: The refined Razza Syandana, enriched further by the sheen of this bronzed Elixis skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2R.descriptionEn: The refined Razza Syandana, enriched further by the sheen of this bronzed Elixis skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2R.descriptionZh: 精致的类种披饰在古铜色的皮革映衬下更显光彩夺目。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2S.name: Ki'Teer Razza Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2S.description: Exude style and poise with this refined accessory.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2S.descriptionEn: Exude style and poise with this refined accessory.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape2S.descriptionZh: 用这款精致的配饰来彰显出格调与风度。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape3S.name: Ki'Teer Straed Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape3S.description: Flaunt your impeccable taste in a Ki'Teer original syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape3S.descriptionEn: Flaunt your impeccable taste in a Ki'Teer original syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaroCape3S.descriptionZh: 身着 Ki'Teer 的原创披饰炫耀你无可挑剔的品味。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaruukDelu.name: Khinn Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaruukDelu.description: The glow of the Khinn Syandana inspires inward reflection.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaruukDelu.descriptionEn: The glow of the Khinn Syandana inspires inward reflection.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BaruukDelu.descriptionZh: 经行披饰的光芒激发着内心的沉思。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BillowingC.name: Cumulus Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BillowingC.description: Roiling and swirling with the promise and threat of a thunderhead, the Cumulus Syandana is for those Tenno who dwell among the clouds.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BillowingC.descriptionEn: Roiling and swirling with the promise and threat of a thunderhead, the Cumulus Syandana is for those Tenno who dwell among the clouds.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BillowingC.descriptionZh: 在雷霆的允诺和威力下飘摇吧，这个积云披饰是为那些住在云间的 Tenno 们所设计的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BrassAndGo.name: Kyroptera Ormolu Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BrassAndGo.description: Custom edition of the Kyroptera Syandana forged by Tenno artisans.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BrassAndGo.descriptionEn: Custom edition of the Kyroptera Syandana forged by Tenno artisans.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/BrassAndGo.descriptionZh: 经由 Tenno 工匠所打造的订制版蝙蝠披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CenturionC.name: Centuria Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CenturionC.description: Take command with this imposing cloak.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CenturionC.descriptionEn: Take command with this imposing cloak.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CenturionC.descriptionZh: 带着这壮丽的斗篷来发出指令。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CephSyanda.name: Boolean Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CephSyanda.description: A procedurally-designed Syandana possessed of proportions pleasing to 87.8% of Cephalons.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CephSyanda.descriptionEn: A procedurally-designed Syandana possessed of proportions pleasing to 87.8% of Cephalons.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CephSyanda.descriptionZh: 一件由程序设计的披饰，可以取悦 87.8% 的中枢。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CitrineDel.name: Corazon Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CitrineDel.description: Delicate blooms framed by vicious thorns warn: beauty can still be deadly. Citrine Aphrodita’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CitrineDel.descriptionEn: Delicate blooms framed by vicious thorns warn: beauty can still be deadly. Citrine Aphrodita’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CitrineDel.descriptionZh: 娇艳的花朵被恶毒的荆棘衬托，警示着：美丽也可能致命。Citrine 美神的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ConclaveCa.name: Celestia Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ConclaveCa.description: Displays Daily and Weekly Conclave Challenge and Mission progress, with a beam of light for each completed challenge or mission.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ConclaveCa.descriptionEn: Displays Daily and Weekly Conclave Challenge and Mission progress, with a beam of light for each completed challenge or mission.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ConclaveCa.descriptionZh: 能够在每天和每周显示武形秘仪挑战和任务进程，每完成一项挑战或任务便会点亮一道光。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpAladSca.name: Opulas Robe
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpAladSca.description: An opulent display of privilege for the Corpus elite becomes a trophy for the Tenno who fight them.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpAladSca.descriptionEn: An opulent display of privilege for the Corpus elite becomes a trophy for the Tenno who fight them.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpAladSca.descriptionZh: 一组特別赐给 Corpus 精英华贵展示品，如今成为与之对抗的 Tenno 的战利品。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpCubinat.name: Flox Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpCubinat.description: A Corpus-inspired Syandana that responds to the wearer's well-being, unfolding in response to damage. As you endure the Flox unfolds.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpCubinat.descriptionEn: A Corpus-inspired Syandana that responds to the wearer's well-being, unfolding in response to damage. As you endure the Flox unfolds.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpCubinat.descriptionZh: 一款受 Corpus 所启发的披饰，反映穿着者的状态，受到伤害时披饰展开。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpMBundle.name: Quaro Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpMBundle.description: Extol the virtues of Profit with this Corpus-styled Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpMBundle.descriptionEn: Extol the virtues of Profit with this Corpus-styled Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpMBundle.descriptionZh: 以这件 Corpus 风格的披饰来赞扬利润的美德。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpModular.name: Vexillus Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpModular.description: March through the battlefield with this Corpus cloak.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpModular.descriptionEn: March through the battlefield with this Corpus cloak.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/CrpModular.descriptionZh: 身着这件 Corpus 斗篷于战场上行军。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxSquareC.name: Lustratus Conquest Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxSquareC.description: Reclaimed from the battlefields of Tau, this battle-worn syandana reflects the cost of war.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxSquareC.descriptionEn: Reclaimed from the battlefields of Tau, this battle-worn syandana reflects the cost of war.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxSquareC.descriptionZh: 这件从 Tau 的战场上缴获的披饰，饱经战火洗礼，它反映了战争的代价。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxTwoTail.name: Lustratus Warbanner Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxTwoTail.description: A syandana once worn to distinguish Dax commanders on Tau; wear it now as a mark of pride.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxTwoTail.descriptionEn: A syandana once worn to distinguish Dax commanders on Tau; wear it now as a mark of pride.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DaxTwoTail.descriptionZh: 这是曾经用来在 Tau 上区分禁卫指挥官的披饰；现在佩戴它是一种荣耀的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DeimosSupp.name: Khrusos Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DeimosSupp.description: Resembling a butterfly's wings emerging from their chrysalis, this Syandana seems infused with mystical power.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DeimosSupp.descriptionEn: Resembling a butterfly's wings emerging from their chrysalis, this Syandana seems infused with mystical power.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DeimosSupp.descriptionZh: 宛如蝴蝶的翅膀破蛹而出，这款披饰似乎被注入了神秘的力量。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DexScarf.name: Dex Nouchali Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DexScarf.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the fourth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DexScarf.descriptionEn: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the fourth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DexScarf.descriptionZh: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻催眠中醒来 4 周年。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DinoSpikeS.name: Yamako Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DinoSpikeS.description: Once worn exclusively by Orokin Judiciary, the Yamako Syandana is a symbol of wisdom and authority.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DinoSpikeS.descriptionEn: Once worn exclusively by Orokin Judiciary, the Yamako Syandana is a symbol of wisdom and authority.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DinoSpikeS.descriptionZh: 山越披饰是一种传统的 Tenno 服饰。曾经只有奥罗金的法官才能穿戴，山越披饰是智慧和权威的象征。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTD2025Mo.name: Monarcierro Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTD2025Mo.description: Embody the festive spirit with this brightly painted syandana that evokes a magnificent bird.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTD2025Mo.nameEn: Monarcierro Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTD2025Mo.descriptionEn: Embody the festive spirit with this brightly painted syandana that evokes a magnificent bird.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTD2025Mo.descriptionZh: 这款色彩鲜艳、犹如尊贵飞鸟的披饰体现了节日风采。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTDWolfBa.name: Saturn Six Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTDWolfBa.description: Pay tribute to the fallen with this festive syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTDWolfBa.nameEn: Saturn Six Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTDWolfBa.descriptionEn: Pay tribute to the fallen with this festive syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DOTDWolfBa.descriptionZh: 以这款节日披饰向逝者致敬。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DraculaCap.name: Dhampyre Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DraculaCap.description: Own the night with this sinister syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DraculaCap.descriptionZh: 通过这件诡异披饰来主宰黑夜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DuelistSya.name: Durumi Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DuelistSya.description: The wish for a long life is carried upon the noble wings of Narin's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/DuelistSya.descriptionZh: 长寿的愿望承载在 Narin 标志性披饰的高贵羽翼之上。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.name: Volca Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.description: Ember's Fourth Law of Thermodynamics: look good doing it.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.descriptionEn: Ember's Fourth Law of Thermodynamics: look good doing it.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.descriptionZh: Ember 的热力学第四定律：做起来要好看点。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.name: Bennu Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.description: The signature syandana of Ember Vermillion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.descriptionEn: The signature syandana of Ember Vermillion.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EmberDelux.descriptionZh: Ember 朱红的标志性披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.name: Asa Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.description: A traditional Tenno garment, this Syandana is woven from ancient, Orokin synthetic thread.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.descriptionEn: A traditional Tenno garment, this Syandana is woven from ancient, Orokin synthetic thread.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.descriptionZh: 传统 Tenno 服装，这条披饰源自远古时期，由奥罗金合成纤维所编织而成。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.name: Asa Phased Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.description: The Void's corrupting energy has scarred this syandana, leaving it permanently out of phase with conventional space.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.descriptionEn: The Void's corrupting energy has scarred this syandana, leaving it permanently out of phase with conventional space.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EnergyScar.descriptionZh: 虚空的堕落能量让这件披饰伤痕累累，使它拥有完全迥异的外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EquinoxDel.name: Circadian Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EquinoxDel.description: Rise and fall, ebb and flow, peace and war. A signature Syandana for Equinox.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EquinoxDel.descriptionEn: Rise and fall, ebb and flow, peace and war. A signature Syandana for Equinox.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/EquinoxDel.descriptionZh: 盛衰兴废，潮起潮落，玉帛干戈。Equinox 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ErosionCap.name: Abrasys Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ErosionCap.description: Evokes stone scarred but not destroyed by the sea's tireless onslaught.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ErosionCap.descriptionEn: Evokes stone scarred but not destroyed by the sea's tireless onslaught.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/ErosionCap.descriptionZh: 让人联想起那被不休海潮冲刷得伤痕累累却又没有破裂的巨石。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FireFlySca.name: Igaro Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FireFlySca.description: This wing-like syandana invokes the beauty and agility of the Ceresean Butterfly Sparrow.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FireFlySca.descriptionEn: This wing-like syandana invokes the beauty and agility of the Ceresean Butterfly Sparrow.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FireFlySca.descriptionZh: 这件翼状般的披饰呼应着自谷神蝶雀的美丽与轻灵。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.name: Pyra Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.description: During the Orokin Era, only the most fierce warriors were permitted to wear this flaming Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.descriptionEn: During the Orokin Era, only the most fierce warriors were permitted to wear this flaming Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.descriptionZh: 在奥罗金时代，只有最凶猛的战士们才被准许穿戴这件火焰般的披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.name: Pyra Opula Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.description: Full spectrum flames dance around this evolved Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.descriptionEn: Full spectrum flames dance around this evolved Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/FlameScarf.descriptionZh: 全光谱的火焰在这个进化后的披饰上舞动。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GarudaCape.name: Suparna Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GarudaCape.description: Flows like grace. Flows like blood. An asymmetrical, stain-resistant Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GarudaCape.descriptionEn: Flows like grace. Flows like blood. An asymmetrical, stain-resistant Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GarudaCape.descriptionZh: 飘姿秀逸、淌若鲜血。一款可防渍的非对称披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.name: Bolide Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.description: Gauss Kresnik’s signature Syandana proves he can stand the heat.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.descriptionEn: Gauss Kresnik’s signature Syandana proves he can stand the heat.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.descriptionZh: Gauss 火神的标志性披饰证明他可以承受住高温的考验。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.name: Tailfin Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.description: Sleekly aerodynamic, Gauss Moto's signature syandana is made for speed.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.descriptionEn: Sleekly aerodynamic, Gauss Moto's signature syandana is made for speed.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GaussDelux.descriptionZh: Gauss 摩托的标志性流线型空气动力学披饰，专为极速而生。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GlassDelux.name: Glistor Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GlassDelux.description: Panes of polished glass complete this elegant Syandana. Like Gara herself, it is less fragile than it looks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GlassDelux.descriptionEn: Panes of polished glass complete this elegant Syandana. Like Gara herself, it is less fragile than it looks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GlassDelux.descriptionZh: 抛光的玻璃让这件优雅的披饰更加完美。就像 Gara 她本人一样，它并不像看上去的那样脆弱。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrendelDel.name: Lumbox Tactical Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrendelDel.description: Be prepared for anything from a firefight to a midnight snack with Grendel Turbis' signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrendelDel.descriptionEn: Be prepared for anything from a firefight to a midnight snack with Grendel Turbis' signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrendelDel.descriptionZh: 佩戴 Grendel 暴坦的标志性披饰，无论是战场交锋还是午夜加餐，都要随时做好准备。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrineerTur.name: Harkonar Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrineerTur.description: A syandana of Grineer design. Matches the Harkonar Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrineerTur.descriptionEn: A syandana of Grineer design. Matches the Harkonar Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrineerTur.descriptionZh: 由 Grineer 设计的披饰。与哈库那护甲套装配套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnAmphisS.name: Amphor Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnAmphisS.description: A syandana assembled from the scavenged internals of some unidentified mechanism, it is still dusty from the desert where it was found.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnAmphisS.descriptionEn: A syandana assembled from the scavenged internals of some unidentified mechanism, it is still dusty from the desert where it was found.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnAmphisS.descriptionZh: 这是一个由一些未被识别的机械内部残骸组装而成的披饰，它依然沾染着从它被发现之地带来的沙砾。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnHoodedC.name: Kuva Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnHoodedC.description: Once worn by an elegant Elder Queen, before time and disease left her body mangled and disfigured.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnHoodedC.descriptionEn: Once worn by an elegant Elder Queen, before time and disease left her body mangled and disfigured.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnHoodedC.descriptionZh: 在身体被时间与疾病给折磨到残破不堪以前，优雅的大女皇曾穿着这件斗篷。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnQueenSc.name: Kuva Braid
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnQueenSc.description: Symbolizing the corrupting power of the Grineer Queens.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnQueenSc.descriptionEn: Symbolizing the corrupting power of the Grineer Queens.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnQueenSc.descriptionZh: 象征了 Grineer 双子女皇的腐化力量。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnStrapsS.name: Laddak Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnStrapsS.description: Fashioned with spare field components this cloak is an example of rarely seen creativity within the Grineer ranks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnStrapsS.descriptionEn: Fashioned with spare field components this cloak is an example of rarely seen creativity within the Grineer ranks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnStrapsS.descriptionZh: 这件由备用的战备零件打造而成的斗篷可是 Grinneer 兵队中罕见的创造性的例证之一。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnTubeSca.name: Rath Kittag Cloak
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnTubeSca.description: A prototype destined for one of Tyl Regor’s experiments, this syandana has been repurposed for Tenno Agents.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnTubeSca.descriptionEn: A prototype destined for one of Tyl Regor’s experiments, this syandana has been repurposed for Tenno Agents.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnTubeSca.descriptionZh: 原为泰尔·雷工众多实验之一的预定原型，这件披饰现已易主为 Tenno 特工所使用。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnVhCape.name: Maggor Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnVhCape.description: Victory over the Grineer, draped across your shoulders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnVhCape.descriptionEn: Victory over the Grineer, draped across your shoulders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/GrnVhCape.descriptionZh: 战胜 Grineer 的象征，披挂在你的肩膀。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Halloween2.name: Izvara Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Halloween2.description: Celebrate the departed with this colorful Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Halloween2.nameEn: Izvara Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Halloween2.descriptionEn: Celebrate the departed with this colorful Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/Halloween2.descriptionZh: 通过这件色彩缤纷的披饰来纪念逝者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenE.name: Abrasys Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenE.nameEn: Abrasys Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenE.descriptionZh: 一件令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.name: Igaro Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.description: An Igaro Syandana adorned with a morbidly festive design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.nameEn: Igaro Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.nameZh: 伊卡洛 亡灵节披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.descriptionEn: An Igaro Syandana adorned with a morbidly festive design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenF.descriptionZh: 令人毛骨悚然的伊卡洛披饰节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.name: Vanquished Banner Day of the Dead
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.description: A Vanquished Banner that has been adorned with a morbidly festive design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.nameEn: Vanquished Banner Day of the Dead
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.nameZh: 战败旗帜 亡灵节披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.descriptionEn: A Vanquished Banner that has been adorned with a morbidly festive design.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenG.descriptionZh: 以令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格所装饰的战败旗帜。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenK.name: Kyroptera Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenK.nameEn: Kyroptera Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HalloweenK.descriptionZh: 一件令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HildrynDel.name: Brising Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HildrynDel.description: The sun rises on the victor and sets upon the vanquished. This is how your legend is made. Adorn yourself with this exquisite syandana, worthy of the sun herself.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HildrynDel.descriptionEn: The sun rises on the victor and sets upon the vanquished. This is how your legend is made. Adorn yourself with this exquisite syandana, worthy of the sun herself.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HildrynDel.descriptionZh: 太阳在胜利者上升起，在被征服者身上落下。这就是你传说的诞生之处。用这个精致的披饰装点自己，无愧于太阳本身。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HolidayTur.name: Imperator Festive Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HolidayTur.description: A festive variation of the Imperator Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HolidayTur.descriptionEn: A festive variation of the Imperator Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HolidayTur.descriptionZh: 一条改款节庆版的凯旋将军披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.name: Rakta Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.description: The Rakta Syandana is awarded by the Red Veil for exemplary valor. This honor is rarely given to outsiders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.descriptionEn: The Rakta Syandana is awarded by the Red Veil for exemplary valor. This honor is rarely given to outsiders.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.descriptionZh: 绯红披饰是来自血色面纱象征英勇典范的奖赏，这项荣誉鲜少给予外来者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.name: Hecate Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.description: Used for festive ceremonies, this Syandana was often worn during social gatherings.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.descriptionEn: Used for festive ceremonies, this Syandana was often worn during social gatherings.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HornSkullS.descriptionZh: 这件披饰经常在节日庆典时的社交场合中穿戴。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HydroidDel.name: Burangara Longcoat
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HydroidDel.description: Get decked out in this coat inspired by the surf and sand.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HydroidDel.descriptionEn: Get decked out in this coat inspired by the surf and sand.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/HydroidDel.descriptionZh: 用这件灵感来自海浪和沙滩的长衣进行一番打扮。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IceSpikeCa.name: Glacia Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IceSpikeCa.description: Jagged, crystalline spikes crown a shroud of snowy mist in this ice themed syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IceSpikeCa.descriptionEn: Jagged, crystalline spikes crown a shroud of snowy mist in this ice themed syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IceSpikeCa.descriptionZh: 在这款以冰为主题的披饰中，参差不齐的冰晶尖刺外笼罩着一层雪雾。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InarosDlxC.name: Scarab Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InarosDlxC.description: The signature syandana of Inaros Ramses.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InarosDlxC.descriptionEn: The signature syandana of Inaros Ramses.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InarosDlxC.descriptionZh: Inaros 拉美西斯的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfBatCape.name: Awlspan Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfBatCape.description: Bring forth the look of your inner beast.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfBatCape.descriptionEn: Bring forth the look of your inner beast.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfCoralSy.name: Sordario Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfCoralSy.description: Pulsing with a bioluminescent glow, this syandana is eye-catchingly contagious.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfCoralSy.descriptionEn: Pulsing with a bioluminescent glow, this syandana is eye-catchingly contagious.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfCoralSy.descriptionZh: 散发着律动般的生物冷光，这款披饰有着引人注目的感染力。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfestedFi.name: Iliac Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfestedFi.description: An infested syandana made from living tissue. Matches the Iliac Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfestedFi.descriptionEn: An infested syandana made from living tissue. Matches the Iliac Armor Set.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfestedFi.descriptionZh: 一个用活体组织制造出的感染披饰。与髂骨护甲组合配套。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfGrnWolf.name: Lycanblight Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfGrnWolf.description: Pursue your prey with a look that combines beast and Infestation.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfGrnWolf.descriptionEn: Pursue your prey with a look that combines beast and Infestation.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfGrnWolf.descriptionZh: 用一种融合了野兽与感染者的外表追击你的猎物。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfMembran.name: Apis Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfMembran.description: Chitin, cartilage and nectar. This Infested Syandana once twitched with unsettling life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfMembran.descriptionEn: Chitin, cartilage and nectar. This Infested Syandana once twitched with unsettling life.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfMembran.descriptionZh: 几丁质、软骨组织，以及花蜜。这件感染披饰曾经发出让人不安的抖动。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfScarfRi.name: Thorac Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfScarfRi.description: A sinuous spine of Infested anatomy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfScarfRi.descriptionEn: A sinuous spine of Infested anatomy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfScarfRi.descriptionZh: 感染者解剖后的弯曲脊椎。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfTentacl.name: Mucusk Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfTentacl.description: A crown of bone spawns a mass of writhing, meaty, Infested tentacles.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfTentacl.descriptionEn: A crown of bone spawns a mass of writhing, meaty, Infested tentacles.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/InfTentacl.descriptionZh: 一件骨盔上恣意生长着扭曲、多肉的感染触手。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraDelux.name: Thiazi Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraDelux.description: The signature syandana of Ivara Skathi.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraDelux.descriptionEn: The signature syandana of Ivara Skathi.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraDelux.descriptionZh: Ivara 冬之女神的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraPrime.name: Apavada Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraPrime.nameZh: 阿帕瓦哒 Prime 披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/IvaraPrime.descriptionZh: Ivara Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/JadeTurtle.name: Imperator Jade Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/JadeTurtle.nameZh: 凯旋将军 翡翠披饰

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazBaroCap.name: Ki'Teer Diax Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazBaroCap.description: Define style with this crystalline cape.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazBaroCap.descriptionEn: Define style with this crystalline cape.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazBaroCap.descriptionZh: 用这款水晶般的披风定义你的风格。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazInfeste.name: Apoxys Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazInfeste.description: This malignant growth hangs elegantly on the shoulders of any Tenno.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazInfeste.descriptionEn: This malignant growth hangs elegantly on the shoulders of any Tenno.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KazInfeste.descriptionZh: 这恶性生长之物可以优雅地披挂于任何 Tenno 的肩膀。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KhoraPrime.name: Kerata Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KhoraPrime.description: Flowing lines meet sharpened spikes in Khora Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KhoraPrime.descriptionEn: Flowing lines meet sharpened spikes in Khora Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KhoraPrime.descriptionZh: 流畅的线条与尖锐的钉刺在 Khora Prime 的标志性披饰中相逢。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KulervoDel.name: Culpa Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KulervoDel.description: Once chains of binding guilt, now twisted into a defiant ornament. The signature Syandana of Kullervo Apostate.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KulervoDel.descriptionEn: Once chains of binding guilt, now twisted into a defiant ornament. The signature Syandana of Kullervo Apostate.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/KulervoDel.descriptionZh: 曾是束缚罪孽的锁链，如今扭曲成一个象征反抗的装饰物。这是 Kullervo 叛徒的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasBackpac.name: K.O.L. Drippy-Assisted Tactical Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasBackpac.description: Be prepared no matter where with everything you need for the long haul, including Drippy, the K.O.L. virtual assistant. 'No need for waterworks, Drippy is here to help!'
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasBackpac.nameZh: 即时网滴答助攻战术披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasBackpac.descriptionEn: Be prepared no matter where with everything you need for the long haul, including Drippy, the K.O.L. virtual assistant. "No need for waterworks, Drippy is here to help!"
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasBackpac.descriptionZh: 无论身在何处，都要准备好应对长期发展所需的一切，包括即时网虚拟助手滴答。'无需费力，滴答助你一臂之力！'

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasNightwa.name: Globakk Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasNightwa.description: Only the most highly trained - or highly reckless - Scaldra dare to wear this portable Efervon container.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasNightwa.descriptionEn: Only the most highly trained - or highly reckless - Scaldra dare to wear this portable Efervon container.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LasNightwa.descriptionZh: 只有训练有素——或者极其鲁莽——的炽蛇军才敢佩戴这种便携式艾弗旺容器。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LavosDelux.name: Aculea Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LavosDelux.description: Many a specimen has felt the sting of this wearable apparatus. Lavos Khymia’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LavosDelux.descriptionEn: Many a specimen has felt the sting of this wearable apparatus. Lavos Khymia’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LavosDelux.descriptionZh: 许多实验对象都曾感受到这件可穿戴设备的刺痛。Lavos 点金的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LimboDelux.name: Sidereal Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LimboDelux.description: A Syandana that dances upon the eddies of battle and void-currents alike.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LimboDelux.descriptionEn: A Syandana that dances upon the eddies of battle and void-currents alike.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LimboDelux.descriptionZh: 一款在战场及虚空流电的旋涡上舞动的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LisetScarf.name: Domus Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LisetScarf.description: Take to the stars with this sleek Syandana. Strapping in feels just like home.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LisetScarf.descriptionEn: Take to the stars with this sleek Syandana. Strapping in feels just like home.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/LisetScarf.descriptionZh: 带着这款柔滑的披饰前往各种行星。戴着它会有种如家的感觉。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MagDeluxeS.name: Vasa Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MagDeluxeS.descriptionZh: Mag 元气的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MesaDeluxe.name: Constella Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MesaDeluxe.description: Venture into uncharted territory with Mesa Presidio’s signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MesaDeluxe.descriptionEn: Venture into uncharted territory with Mesa Presidio’s signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MesaDeluxe.descriptionZh: 佩戴 Mesa 边塞的标志性披饰前去未知的领域冒险。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MixerKyrop.name: Kyroptera Panoply Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MixerKyrop.description: An elite version of the Kyroptera Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/MixerKyrop.descriptionEn: An elite version of the Kyroptera Syandana.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics or Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock two additional looks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.descriptionEn: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics or Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock two additional looks.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.descriptionZh: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。装备这款披饰收集遗物或阿耶精华时，会额外解锁两个外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Emergent Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics and Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock an additional look.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.descriptionEn: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics and Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock an additional look.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.descriptionZh: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。装备这款披饰收集遗物和阿耶精华时，会额外解锁一个外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.name: Protovyre Apex Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.description: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.descriptionEn: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NarmerEvol.descriptionZh: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NefSyandan.name: Lucra Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NefSyandan.description: Flaunt wealth and prosperity with a constant stream of financial data.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NefSyandan.descriptionEn: Flaunt wealth and prosperity with a constant stream of financial data.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NefSyandan.descriptionZh: 用这股持续不断的财政数据流来炫耀财富与昌盛。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NeurovyreP.name: Neurovyre Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NeurovyreP.description: Painstakingly embellished with scavenged gold as a treaty gift for the Orokin, this Sentient spinal symbiote serves as Caliban Prime’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NeurovyreP.descriptionEn: Painstakingly embellished with scavenged gold as a treaty gift for the Orokin, this Sentient spinal symbiote serves as Caliban Prime’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NeurovyreP.descriptionZh: 作为与奥罗金签订的条约礼物，这个 Sentient 脊椎异融者由搜集而来的黄金精心装饰，是 Caliban Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaDelux.name: Buzhou Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaDelux.description: The strength of the mountain; the grace of flowing water.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaDelux.descriptionEn: The strength of the mountain; the grace of flowing water.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaLever.name: Reshantur Cult Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaLever.description: This humble Syandana is modeled on those worn by the Children of Reshantur, who formed into a clan devoted to Nezha in defense of their home.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaLever.descriptionEn: This humble Syandana is modeled on those worn by the Children of Reshantur, who formed into a clan devoted to Nezha in defense of their home.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NezhaLever.descriptionZh: 这件朴素的披饰是根据瑞圣途的孩子们曾穿戴过的样式设计而来的，那些孩子们组成了一支信奉 Nezha 的小型氏族来保卫他们的家园。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusDelux.name: Nosos Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusDelux.description: The signature Syandana of Nidus Phryke.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusDelux.descriptionEn: The signature Syandana of Nidus Phryke.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusDelux.descriptionZh: Nidus 恐惧神的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusPrime.name: Crinoid Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusPrime.description: Beauty and dread combine in this unique Infested Syandana, alive with swaying gilded tentacles.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusPrime.descriptionEn: Beauty and dread combine in this unique Infested Syandana, alive with swaying gilded tentacles.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NidusPrime.descriptionZh: 美丽与恐惧在这件独特的感染者披饰中融为一体，镀金的触须摇曳生姿。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NokkoSyand.name: Caranthele Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NokkoSyand.description: Nokko’s trusty pack carries everything needed for a long day of caring for the fruits n’ roots. Nokko’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NokkoSyand.descriptionEn: Nokko’s trusty pack carries everything needed for a long day of caring for the fruits n’ roots. Nokko’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NokkoSyand.descriptionZh: Nokko 的可靠背包里装着一整天照料果子和根所需的一切。Nokko 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NoruPrimeS.name: Noru Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NoruPrimeS.description: A relic from another time, this syandana is a highly ornamental and prized garment.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NoruPrimeS.descriptionEn: A relic from another time, this syandana is a highly ornamental and prized garment.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NoruPrimeS.descriptionZh: 来自于其他时代的遗物，这条披饰是一种极具观赏性的珍贵服装。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaDeluxe.name: Danavi Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaDeluxe.descriptionZh: Nova 阿修罗的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaIIDelu.name: Radia Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaIIDelu.description: The signature syandana of Nova Atomica.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaIIDelu.descriptionEn: The signature syandana of Nova Atomica.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NovaIIDelu.descriptionZh: Nova 原子姬的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NyxDeluxeS.name: Enthra Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NyxDeluxeS.description: Strike a cutting figure with Nyx’s mesmerizing signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NyxDeluxeS.descriptionEn: Strike a cutting figure with Nyx’s mesmerizing signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/NyxDeluxeS.descriptionZh: 用 Nyx 迷人的标志性披饰为打造出一个凛冽的仪表。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PacifistSy.name: Akrabu Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PacifistSy.description: This Syandana of corded-knots wrapped in linen is used by Baruuk for meditation and contemplation.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PacifistSy.descriptionEn: This Syandana of corded-knots wrapped in linen is used by Baruuk for meditation and contemplation.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PacifistSy.descriptionZh: 亚麻布包裹的绳状披饰，被 Baruuk 使用于冥想和沉思。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PaxDuviric.name: Ahlto Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PaxDuviric.description: The Void makes its mark on Kullervo's signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PaxDuviric.descriptionEn: The Void makes its mark on Kullervo's signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PaxDuviric.descriptionZh: 虚空在 Kullervo 的标志性披饰上留下了自己的印记。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAkrab.name: Asila Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAkrab.description: The ornate charms on this Syandana represent the ideal of serenity.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAkrab.descriptionEn: The ornate charms on this Syandana represent the ideal of serenity.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAkrab.descriptionZh: 这件披饰上的华丽坠饰代表了宁静的理想。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAltra.name: Altra Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAltra.description: A shining garment befitting the Saint of Altra.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAltra.nameZh: 阿尔特拉 Prime 披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAltra.descriptionEn: A shining garment befitting the Saint of Altra.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAltra.descriptionZh: 适合阿尔特拉圣者的闪亮服装。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeArtif.name: Artifex Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeArtif.description: A techno-organic Syandana, reimagined with regal flair worthy of the Orokin elite.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeArtif.descriptionEn: A techno-organic Syandana, reimagined with regal flair worthy of the Orokin elite.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeArtif.descriptionZh: 一款科技有机披饰，重塑奥罗金精英的高贵气质。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAviaS.name: Avia Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAviaS.description: The bold, wing-like arcs of this Syandana have been crafted to complement the Avia Prime armor.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAviaS.descriptionEn: The bold, wing-like arcs of this Syandana have been crafted to complement the Avia Prime armor.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeAviaS.descriptionZh: 这件不羁的、像翅膀一样的弧形披饰，是为了搭配飞空 Prime 护甲而精心打造的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCapeE.name: Isabeau Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCapeE.description: A flowing river of light and grace, a Syandana fit for royalty.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCapeE.descriptionEn: A flowing river of light and grace, a Syandana fit for royalty.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCapeE.descriptionZh: 充盈着光与优雅的流动之河，此乃适合高贵之人的披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeChrom.name: Impetus Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeChrom.description: A blade-like cut in regal red-and-gold, reminiscent of the elite honor guards of ancient Mars.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeChrom.descriptionEn: A blade-like cut in regal red-and-gold, reminiscent of the elite honor guards of ancient Mars.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeChrom.descriptionZh: 庄严的红色与金色构成的利刃，令人回想起旧日火星上的精英御卫。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCitri.name: Sphatika Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCitri.description: Citrine Prime's signature Syandana sparkles with a brilliant luster.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeCitri.descriptionZh: Citrine Prime 的标志性披饰闪耀着璀璨的光芒。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeFlame.name: Pyra Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeFlame.description: A ceremonial version of the Pyra that drapes the entire back in a cape of flames.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeFlame.descriptionEn: A ceremonial version of the Pyra that drapes the entire back in a cape of flames.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeFlame.descriptionZh: 庆典版的珮菈，一条披挂在背部的火焰披风。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGrend.name: Sumbha Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGrend.description: The signature Syandana of the gilded gourmand, Grendel Prime.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGrend.descriptionEn: The signature Syandana of the gilded gourmand, Grendel Prime.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGrend.descriptionZh: 镀金美食家 Grendel Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGyreS.name: Triodic Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGyreS.description: Enchant onlookers with the crystalline adornments of Gyre Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGyreS.descriptionEn: Enchant onlookers with the crystalline adornments of Gyre Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeGyreS.descriptionZh: 通过 Gyre Prime 标志性披饰的晶莹剔透的装饰来吸引旁观者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeInaro.name: Kahtuss Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeInaro.description: A regal Syandana and a record of Inaros' legacy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeInaro.descriptionEn: A regal Syandana and a record of Inaros' legacy.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeInaro.descriptionZh: 一件帝王的披饰，Inaros 的遗迹的载体。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeLimbo.name: Oblivia Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeLimbo.description: Step into oblivion with the signature syandana of Limbo Prime.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeLimbo.descriptionEn: Step into oblivion with the signature syandana of Limbo Prime.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeLimbo.descriptionZh: 用 Limbo Prime 的标志性披饰步入遗忘边境。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeMerul.name: Merulina Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeMerul.description: Yareli Prime’s faithful water-glider is happy to adorn her body as an additional ornament.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeMerul.nameZh: 浪漪珊瑚 Prime 披饰
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeMerul.descriptionEn: Yareli Prime’s faithful water-glider is happy to adorn her body as an additional ornament.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeMerul.descriptionZh: Yareli Prime 忠实的水上滑行者很乐意成为她身上额外的装饰品。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeNaveS.name: Nave Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeNaveS.description: Invest Harrow Prime with this golden Syandana of holy office.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeNaveS.descriptionEn: Invest Harrow Prime with this golden Syandana of holy office.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeNaveS.descriptionZh: 授予 Harrow Prime 这件圣职用的金色披饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeObero.name: Sukira Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeObero.description: This long, powerful ribbon symbolizes the Tenno path toward balance.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeObero.descriptionEn: This long, powerful ribbon symbolizes the Tenno path toward balance.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeObero.descriptionZh: 这条长而有力的缎带标志着 Tenno 的平衡之道。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeOctav.name: Serenidine Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeOctav.description: Awe the crowds with this majestic flourish of a Syandana, fit for the mistress of the Mandachord.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeOctav.descriptionEn: Awe the crowds with this majestic flourish of a Syandana, fit for the mistress of the Mandachord.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeOctav.descriptionZh: 这款华丽曼妙的披饰，不仅能让听众折服，与那位演奏曼达和弦琴的女音乐家更是绝配。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeReven.name: Aurimus Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeReven.description: A spectral glow emanates from this ornate syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeReven.descriptionEn: A spectral glow emanates from this ornate syandana.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeReven.descriptionZh: 这件华丽的披饰散发着鬼魅的幽光。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeRhopt.name: Rhoptron Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeRhopt.description: Sumptuous details suit Parvos Granum's favored guardian.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeRhopt.descriptionEn: Sumptuous details suit Parvos Granum's favored guardian.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeRhopt.descriptionZh: 华丽的细节非常适合帕尔沃斯·格拉努最喜爱的守护者。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeSurat.name: Surator Prime Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeSurat.description: Feel the energy of the Surator Prime Syandana at your back as you feel the drive to push on.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrimeWukon.name: Jindou Prime Syandana

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrismaRazo.name: Prisma Uru Syandana
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PrismaRazo.description: Shimmering prisma crystals give this syandana a mesmerizing sheen.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Scarves/PS5Syandan.name: Obsidian Sedai Syandana

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Grimoire/P.name: Noctua Lophos

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/Ni.descriptionZh: 重击巨锤的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/So.name: Motherwrench Hammer Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Hammers/So.description: Leave the Corpus in no doubt as to where your allegiance lies with this iconic Solaris utility item. Lift together, smack 'em down together.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/A.name: Bladeswarm Vectis Skin

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.description: The glacial cold of the Glaxion freeze ray is now reflected on its exterior.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.nameZh: 冷冻光束步枪 冰魄外观
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/C.descriptionZh: 冷冻光束步枪冰冻射线的刺骨寒意如今已映照在其表面上。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/G.name: Bloodfrenzy Nagantaka Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/G.description: A bloodthirsty Nagantaka skin for those who prefer to use a crossbow at close range.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/H.name: Renuntio Speargun Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/H.description: Renounce heresy with this signature speargun skin for Harrow Reliquary.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/H.descriptionEn: Renounce heresy with this signature speargun skin for Harrow Reliquary.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/R.name: Niveus Quellor Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/R.description: The Quellor's reliable cryo-blasts wrapped in a new frigid package.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/S.name: Burston Solstice Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/S.description: A festive skin for the Burston.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/LongGuns/S.descriptionEn: A festive skin for the Burston.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Machete/Gr.name: Kludgekil Machete Skin

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Bi.name: Stratus Pistol Skin

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Ce.name: Pandero Ceramica Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Ce.description: A bold red and white glaze glisten across the surface of this hardened ceramic Pandero skin.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Ga.descriptionZh: 这款布里斯提卡外观体现了'如果你的武器很干净，说明你没有正确使用它'的理念。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Tn.name: Zundi Dual Pistol Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Pistols/Tn.description: As no Zundi weapons survive from the Old War this formidable pistol skin was created to honor them. Stout, distinctive and intimidating it is a reminder of times past.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Redeemer/R.descriptionEn: Slice and blast in supreme style with this exclusive skin for the Redeemer gunblade.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Weapons/Swords/Sph.descriptionZh: 这把不同寻常的长剑外观上留有来自遥远国度的寻觅者的印记。剑柄周围模糊的蚀刻纹饰拼出了神秘的短语'索罗斯 I'，然而其含义早已湮没在历史长河中。

Rail agents told of the legendary battle between Sevagoth Glaukus and Hydroid Rakkam. Agents looked on as the pair disappeared into the Void, locked in combat. Nobody knows how much of the old railer's tale is true.

This skin features a custom Tombstone and Sevagoth's Lullaby, a custom song that plays for Sevagoth's Shadow.
